subject: Re: MAP draft & updated close date - Acme Healthcare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealthcare.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealthcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & target close date - Acme Healthcare

Hi Alice / Tom -

Thanks again for taking time yesterday - wanted to follow up with a concise post-call recap and a draft Mutual Action Plan (attached) so we have aligned next steps. Key points from the call: 

- Objective: Pilot Redwood inference on a subset of Acme's patient-facing workflows to validate latency, cost, and security controls.
- Current target close date (prelim): 2026-12-15 (PO + pilot kickoff)
- Proposed milestones in attached MAP-draft-v2.xlsx:
  1) Security review: Acme to send security questionnaire answers (owner: Acme Security) / Redwood to provide SOC2 evidence and design docs (owner: Marissa / Rishi) - dependency: security call.
  2) Pilot scoping & data access: define test dataset and access method (owner: Acme Product / Redwood SE) - dependency: legal & DPA.
  3) Pilot run & results: 2-week pilot with agreed SLAs (owner: Acme Product / Redwood Ops).
  4) Procurement & PO: internal Acme procurement and budget sign-off (owner: Acme Finance).

Actions we committed to:
- I will circulate the MAP draft (attached) and a short SOW template.
- Rishi will gather SOC2 artifacts and be available for the security call next week.
- Dev can support a technical deep-dive (KV/cache, batching, infra) if needed.

Please: review the attached MAP and confirm: (a) owners listed are correct, (b) any missing dependencies, and (c) whether the 12/15 close date is still realistic given your fiscal/process calendar.

Next step suggestion: 30-min checkpoint next Tue (11/24) to lock owners and finalize the MAP. Happy to shift if your team needs more time.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (MAP with milestones/responsibilities), SOW-template.docx (SOW stub)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

--
Redwood Inference - making inference predictable and economical

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealthcare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealthcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & target close date - Acme Healthcare

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. A few updates from our side after running this up the chain: 

1) Budget & timeline: Finance has a quarterly procurement window that effectively pushes executable POs out to the next quarter. For planning we should re-forecast the target close date to 2027-01-31.

2) Prioritization: Given limited engineering bandwidth, Acme would like to prioritize a short pilot (POC) with a constrained dataset first, and postpone full production rollout milestones. So please move the "Pilot scoping & run" milestone earlier and defer the "Production rollout" workstream to a separate phase.

3) Security: We will complete the security questionnaire, but we need SOC2 artifacts and a short architecture diagram (network/data flow) to circulate to our InfoSec team. Can Rishi and/or Dev prepare those?

I've attached our annotated SOW (SOW-comments.pdf) with procurement contact details (PO owner: Tom Reynolds, tom.reynolds@acmehealthcare.com).

Proposed next steps:
- Updated MAP with re-forecast close date and reprioritized milestones (Marissa)
- Security evidence packet from Redwood (Rishi)
- Schedule security sync with Acme InfoSec and Dev deep-dive the week of 11/29

Appreciate it - will confirm internally once I have a final procurement timeline.

Best,
Alice
Director of Product, Acme Healthcare
alice.zhang@acmehealthcare.com

--
Attachment: SOW-comments.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealthcare.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmehealthcare.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & updated close date - Acme Healthcare

Thanks Alice - understood and thanks for the annotated SOW. I've updated the MAP to reflect the re-forecast close date and the reprioritized milestones. High-level changes are below and I've attached MAP-updated-20261123.xlsx for review.

Updated MAP summary (key changes):
- New target close date: 2027-01-31 (was 2026-12-15) - updates applied to all milestone due dates.
- Milestone reprioritization:
  * Phase 1 (Pilot - priority):
    - Week 0 (kickoff): finalize pilot scope & dataset (owner: Acme Product / Marissa) - due 2026-12-08
    - Week 1-2: Pilot execution & telemetry collection (owner: Acme Product / Redwood Ops) - due 2026-12-22
  * Phase 2 (Procurement & PO):
    - Procurement alignment & PO issuance (owner: Tom Reynolds / Acme Finance) - target 2027-01-15
  * Phase 3 (Security sign-off & production activities):
    - Security evidence review and sign-off (owner: Acme InfoSec / Rishi) - target 2027-01-24

Redwood commitments we are confirming now:
- Rishi will assemble SOC2 artifacts (system description, audit report excerpt) and the short network/data-flow diagram by 11/27.
- Dev (cc'd) will be the primary SE for the technical deep-dive; propose week of 11/29 for the call.
- I'll share the updated MAP and SOW links in HubSpot and the shared Drive.

Please review MAP-updated-20261123.xlsx and confirm owners / feasibility of dates. If this looks good, I'll lock the MAP and create a weekly 30-min checkpoint cadence (Tuesdays) starting 11/30.

Attachments: MAP-updated-20261123.xlsx

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Marissa / Alice - quick confirmation from procurement side:

- We can align to the 2027-01-31 re-forecast.
- Procurement will aim to issue a PO by 2027-01-15 as noted; I'll be the procurement owner.
- For scheduling, Acme Product would like a final demo week between Jan 9-13 (we'll reserve that window).

I'll watch for the SOC2 packet and the security call invite. Thanks for moving the MAP items around - this structure makes the pilot-focused approach much easier for our stakeholders to approve.
